DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terrors (Sleep Terrors)

Based on the age of the patient (8 years old) and the presentation of waking up frightened with complex movements or episodes of fear without full awakening or recall, the clinical picture is consistent with Night Terrors. The lack of clear external triggers like loud noises or flashing lights, and the nature of the episodes described, further supports this diagnosis over sleepwalking or external causes.
